name: What is the typical timeline for in-law suite construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for in-law suite construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for an in-law suite varies depending on the project's scope. A garage conversion or renovation of existing interior space might take 2-4 months from start to finish, including design and permitting. A new attached addition or a detached accessory dwelling unit (ADU) could take 5-9 months or longer. Factors like permitting approval times, material availability, and the complexity of finishes all influence the overall duration of the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines range from 2-4 months for conversions to 5-9+ months for new additions, depending on project scope and permitting.
